description: Two-step. First call with confirm=false to see what the guest gets back if they cancel now (nothing changes). Tell the guest that refund and get their go-ahead, then call again with confirm=true and expected_refund_cents set to the refund amount from the first call. If the refund changed in between, the call fails with refund_changed instead of cancelling. Refunds go to the guest's card automatically. Pass guest_email (the email the booking was made with) unless you connect with an agent token.

booking_id.description: The booking or request to cancel.

confirm.description: False to preview the refund without changing anything; true to cancel.

expected_refund_cents.description: Required when confirm is true: refund.amount from the confirm=false call.

guest_email.description: The email the booking was made with. Needed unless you connect with an agent token.

name: cancel_booking

outputSchema.description: With confirm=false, what the guest would get back if they cancelled now; with confirm=true, the cancelled booking and the refund.

refund.description: An amount in cents with its currency.

title: Cancel a booking or request
